seasons.title: ICAR-IIVR cultivation details
seasons.quote: Sowing time: Rabi: Sept; Kharif: June–July; Summer: Jan.

days_to_first_harvest.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: Tomato fruit maturity starts after 70-100 days after transplanting depending upon the variety.

harvest_span_days.title: ICAR-IIVR cultivation details
harvest_span_days.note: Last picking at 120 days after transplanting minus first picking at 70 days (KAU) = 50 days.

height_max_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
height_max_cm.quote: Stake the plants 30 days after planting with 1 - 1.5 m tall stakes
height_max_cm.note: Staked height 1.5 m (upper end of the stake length). The NC State range (up to 10 ft) is for the whole species and was not used.

sun.title: NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
sun.quote: Light: Full sun (6 or more hours of direct sunlight a day)

water_need.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (aftercultivation)
water_need.quote: Irrigate at two or three days interval.
water_need.note: Interpreted: the source recommends regular irrigation every few days in summer; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (climate)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: However, it cannot withstand water logging.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: On an average, yield of open pollinated varieties ranges from 200-250 q/ha.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: 200 q/ha = 2.0 kg/m²; open-pollinated, the lower figure.

kc.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 6: Table 12, single crop coefficients (Kc)
kc.note: Kc ini is the group value.

kc.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 6: Table 12, single crop coefficients (Kc)
kc.note: Kc end is 0.70-0.90; the lower end is stored. Tomato on stakes uses a higher Kc (FAO footnote 2).

source_notes: AI research batch 1 (2026-10-05). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are national ICAR-IIVR months (no Malwa-specific source found yet).

sow_windows.title: ICAR-IIVR cultivation details
sow_windows.quote: Sowing time: Rabi: Sept; Kharif: June–July; Summer: Jan.
sow_windows.note: Nursery sowing months from the source, shifted by the nursery days so the window is the transplant date the planner uses.
